title: GD cross-domain supply: source-constrained nominal reference, restriction and cause selection
decision: Offer prospective common meaning as predicate-supported nominal reference, with independently paid anchoring and quantifier/causal constructions. Retain three diverse source opportunities; no new card, experiment, nominalizer repair or target binding.

common_word_offer.plain_meaning: what satisfies the written description / that which ...
common_word_offer.core: For each explicitly declared sort T, a written predicate P:T->Truth yields a nominal description D:T->Truth with D(x)=P(x). This closes a written description for use as a nominal constituent; it does not supply P or invent x.
common_word_offer.explicit_cost: Description formation, actual reference anchoring, definite/existential/universal force, and explanatory linkage are distinct paid contributions. The core alone is not a noun, an assertion, a cause or a participant introduction.
common_word_offer.domain_generality: The same predicate-to-description contribution may be hypothesized over written material, person/kind or event predicates. Sort and predicate must already be written under a declared whole construction; no Wind-to-Water, Event-to-Property, Spec-to-Frame or Kind-to-Instance cast.
common_word_offer.anaphoric_consumer: A separately paid THAT(id,D) construction checks the written prior participant satisfies D and preserves its identity. No latest-anything fallback or identification across unpaid text.
common_word_offer.restrictive_consumer: A separately paid EACH/ANY/NONE construction ranges over D and supplied source/domain scope; it contributes quantifier force instead of hiding a full proposition in D.
common_word_offer.causal_consumer: An explanation construction takes written propositions with their asserted, reported or hypothesized commitment; a nominal event reference is not automatically a true explanatory proposition.
common_word_offer.negative_controls: An empty/unwritten P gives no interpretation; free name lookup with no predicate cannot use the closure; two satisfying individuals are not collapsed by an unstated definite uniqueness rule.
common_word_offer.whole_residual_limit: Finite exact whole licenses and entry contexts remain required. A residual that contains an entire historical claim removes the proposed shared contribution and earns no composition credit.
common_word_offer.warning: This is a concrete prospective meaning family, not a recovered aN gloss. The three source traditions do not demonstrate the same lexeme or source language. No universal occurrence-wise type switch is licensed.

opportunities.name: Event nominal reference versus explanatory proposition
opportunities.whole_source_unit: Megenberg II25 complete owned chapter; focal complete opening generation/perception block91.14–92.10, before stone-identity objection. Remaining chapter stays available and is not claimed translated.
opportunities.historical_layer: Medieval natural-philosophy work via cached TITUS/Pfeiffer1861 electronic extraction; literal chapter boundary independently checked, no new manuscript collation.
exact_source_anchors: 91.28–30: aber daz reizen, daz der dunst tuot ... daz haizt der tonr
92.3–6: daz ist dar umb, daz ... dark/thick clouds extinguish flames, therefore thunder is heard without visible lightning
92.7–10: remote ignition/attenuated report explains seeing lightning without hearing thunder
complete_focal_content: Warm light fatty vapour rises toward the cold cloud region, is driven back repeatedly, then hurled downward rapidly and ignites in flight.
Its flames are named lightning; the rending it does in clouds/air is named thunder. The two therefore occur together in the account.
Sight precedes hearing because the visual sense reaches farther/faster; a washing/beating example illustrates that order.

The objection that one is sometimes perceived without the other gets two explanations: cloud darkness/thickness quenches the flame for invisible lightning; remote ignition prevents the sound reaching the observer.
real_predicates: REND(e,vapour,clouds/air) identifies the nominal event subsequently named thunder; NAME(e,thunder) does not identify the material vapour with the event.
DARK_THICK(clouds) and EXTINGUISH(clouds,flames) explain HEAR(thunder) with NOT_SEE(lightning).
REMOTE(ignition,observer) and NOT_REACH(sound,observer) explain SEE(lightning) with NOT_HEAR(thunder).
opportunities.possible_shared_contribution: Close the written rending predicate as an event description, then anchor the event for naming. Separately resume a whole written explanation proposition with its assertion scope. This supplies nominal referent content beyond an opaque record identifier.
changing_consequences: Replacing event e with material vapour changes what is named thunder, even though agent/material participants stay fixed.
Swapping the two explanation arguments reverses which perception is absent: thick clouds account for absent seeing, remoteness for absent hearing.
Causal co-occurrence does not entail both senses perceive both phenomena. Preserve observer and perception predicates.
source_limits: The sense-speed and generation claims are historical source assertions, not modern physical measurements.
daz, dar umb and English that/because are different constructions; their source wording does not establish one cross-domain lexeme.
No universal every-aN nominalizer, thunder noun, weather owner or manuscript acoustic alignment is chosen.
predecessors: IDEA000614 already owns three acoustic causes later in92.30–93.7; this offer is not another sound-triplet fit or reopening of its owned-acoustic-target gate.
IDEA000783/AB retains a whole causal draft but unknown intervening text cannot prove event identity; no latest-event rule is inherited.
IDEA000030 preserves that temporal sequencing may describe causally dependent worlds; matching the physical story cannot identify BECAUSE.
opportunities.next_opportunity: Only if root chooses this source account, write actual nominal predicate plus its separately scoped naming/explanation consumers in one complete owned unit. Compare material-versus-event and perception-scope alternatives without fetching targets or using the old thunder triplet as a selection device.

opportunities.name: Predicate-restricted command recipients and free-choice capability
opportunities.whole_source_unit: Complete Cato De agri cultura133.1–4, heading, ground shoots, named-kind list, careful basket/pot branch, capability claim and separate vine branch.
opportunities.historical_layer: Ancient agricultural content through owned Hooper/Ash1934 Loeb witness; earlier Goetz label corrected. No pre1450 donor/copying claim.
exact_source_anchors: Quae diligentius seri voles, in calicibus seri oportet
Eo modo quod vis genus arborum facere poteris uti radices bene habeant
real_predicates: The nominal restriction WANT_CAREFUL_PLANTING(reader,x) selects the objects receiving the pot/basket planting instruction, instead of another fixed plant-kind name.
A named list resumes as all listed kinds; the later wanted-more-careful restriction may select none, some or all, without asserting a proper subset.
The capability claim is about the tree kind the addressee wishes, using the stated method; it does not assert an actually rooted specimen of every kind.
opportunities.possible_shared_contribution: Nominal closure of a written wanted-more-careful predicate preserves its restriction. A distinct universal/free-choice consumer and method/capability predicate carry quantifier and modal force. The same closure must not silently turn kinds into specimens.
changing_consequences: With the plant-kind inventory fixed, changing the stated reader selection changes command recipients while leaving the prior all-kind resumption intact.
A capability claim remains meaningful without asserting planting was performed or rooting succeeded.
Substituting the latest listed kind for the entire resumed class removes obligations to earlier kinds; substituting a kind for the physically threaded branch changes argument sort.
source_limits: Who/what exactly the quae selection ranges over in an authored target requires a paid kind/specimen relationship; root must retain source botanical and age/container uncertainties.
Free-choice, universal, existential and definite force are not interchangeable glosses for one nominal closure.
Ground-shoot rooting purpose, careful basket procedure and vine one-year branch all remain complete-source duties.
predecessors: 838 already supplies class resumption/subset content; this explicit prospective nominal restriction is a strengthening, not a new card.
GDT1001 exact192atom/96type tree fails both serializers0/1108; no shrunken tree or serialization repair.

IDEA000568 already executed predicate-to-description restriction under a sole origin description and retained constant-on-D/name rivals plus source/reader failures. Multiple written restrictors must actually change scope; another modifier call alone is insufficient.
opportunities.next_opportunity: Try the common nominal contribution over the all-kind resumption and wanted selection under separately paid quantifier rules in a suitable complete owned account. Root must expose actual written P and consumers, rather than supplying a list of unseen meanings.

opportunities.name: Any/none of a written cause set with report versus actuality scope
opportunities.whole_source_unit: Complete owned Internet Classics Archive Prognostic Part2, H01–H10, from initial examination through final mortal-lips assertion.
opportunities.historical_layer: Ancient work in Francis Adams English translation tradition; exact MIT print exemplar and medieval witness unresolved. Historical prognosis only.
exact_source_anchors: if any of these causes be confessed to
whether or not ... proceeded from these causes
if none of these be said to exist
the same inquiries as formerly directed
real_predicates: The queried set comprises prolonged sleeplessness, loose bowels and food deprivation for the same patient; ANY_ADMITTED in that written set reduces estimated danger.
Admission/report is not proof that the appearance actually arose from the admitted cause; the day-and-night course clarifies the proposed origin.
The paired none-reported and not-subsiding clauses precede severe prognosis, with their printed connective ambiguity retained.
Third/fourth-day inquiry resumes the same question frame while adding other signs; it does not introduce a second arbitrary cause catalogue.
opportunities.possible_shared_contribution: Close a written candidate-cause predicate as a nominal domain. THESE fixes membership to the actual earlier query; ANY/NONE applies to the reported/admitted relation in that domain. A separate EXPLAINED_BY connects actual finding and actual proposed cause. Reported existence and actual cause remain different proposition scopes.
changing_consequences: Hold the face appearance fixed but admit one queried cause: the source danger estimate changes without guaranteeing survival.
Admit an unrelated unqueried condition: it cannot automatically satisfy ANY_OF_THESE.
A patient may confess a queried antecedent while the appearance is not in fact caused by it; changing report truth alone cannot silently establish the causal-origin proposition.
Adding new third/fourth-day signs does not change the identity of the repeated inquiry frame.
source_limits: The paired if-clauses and sleep-eye diarrhea/purgation/habit exclusions keep their original and/or ambiguity; no convenient Boolean truth table is imposed.
Reduced danger, fatal sign, very deadly sign and imminent-death claim remain distinct.
Full adverse-face bundle and H07–H10 eye/eyelid/lip/nose signs remain complete-unit obligations; this nominal sketch is not a full clinical reading.
predecessors: 438/396 already own the observation/history/time mechanism; no new card from changing its title to nominalization.
Clinical413 partial whole account and structural same-query possibility do not select patient/cause/anaphor meanings.
IDEA17 cannot equate anaphora with a lexical definiteness switch; identity history must be written separately.
IDEA30 cannot infer causal connective from conditional outcome variation alone.
opportunities.next_opportunity: In a prospective complete clinical C0, require one written query set reused under ANY, NONE and same-query continuation; record the actual predicates and report commitments. This is a source-constrained offer, not an automatic clinical413 reopen or a fresh capacity census.

old_dictionary_boundary.root_supplied_fact: 1028 ZL complete f107v45–49 contains two AIIN with old guessed WATER nounkind and one DAIIN with old guessed BECAUSE relation. Root independently supplies this count; producer did not open ALL_POSITIONS or target artifacts.
old_dictionary_boundary.retained_positive: Source-conditioned whole49-group account distinguishes same food, discarded W0, different W1, quoted operation and intention/capability/actuality. Those are explicit constructed consequences, not independent word truth.
old_dictionary_boundary.why_no_direct_bridge: WATER as a kind atom is not a nominal description, and BECAUSE as a relation is not an entity. The proposed closure cannot simply cast either old value into the desired shared type. Reinterpreting either requires a separate prospective complete grammar, not an unchanged1028 continuation.
old_dictionary_boundary.no_trivial_clash: Incompatibility of two independently invented local dictionaries does not reject all aN meanings or establish this alternative. The active1131 A/B/C semantics were not inspected.
old_dictionary_boundary.unbound_d_aN_construction: A phrase equivalent to on-account-of-that would need an explicit d-like explanation constructor over a written proposition and its nominal reference. This producer assigns no d meaning, no bare-AIIN water predicate and no daiin=BECAUSE decomposition.

retained_countercases.fact: Frame->Spec NOM cannot consume its own Spec output under the fixed ar/ar rule; no hidden cast/idempotence/reader selection repairs.
Actual predicate restriction applications did not select the organ dictionary; sole-origin D leaves constant-on-D and separate-name rivals, source analogy gap and alternate failures.
TOPIC/CURRENT are distinct constructed graphs but SEPARATE/NOMINAL_EVENT scope graphs are identical through executed prefix; no reference policy or nominal interpretation selected.
Latest-written-flow antecedent success is stipulated; unpaid intervening words and further unknown predicate do not constrain event identity.
Anaphora may coexist with definiteness; causal worlds may be narrated sequentially. Source-compatible effects do not locate lexical function.

novelty_decision: No new raw card: Cato restriction and prognosis cause-set content already have cards, while the Megenberg nominal/explanation contrast is an inspected source opportunity rather than a complete distinct target/design contract. Three explicit possible contributions may help root author a prospective shared common word; no novelty certification or new confirmation capacity.
